text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Phew...
choice_data_list: Are you okay with the heat?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... In fact, I'd say I still have 
plenty of energy to spare...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'd like to increase the intensity a 
bit, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I have been quite sturdy ever since I was 
a child... So I do not believe the risk of 
injury is anything to fear."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To build strength properly, we can't go 
too easy. Judging from her usual training, 
she's certainly on the resilient side.
choice_data_list:
Alright, shall we raise the intensity a 
bit?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Well then, I shall go for one more 
rep.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Just standing in the sea up to 
your knees really increases the load on 
squats, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To think it takes so much bracing just to 
resist the pulling force of the waves...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
However, this is much more efficient than 
simply increasing reps. Please give me one 
more set.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash—splash!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: N-Yes...! I can still keep going...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've felt how good her core and muscle 
balance were from the beginning, but... 
she's enduring even more strain than I 
anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we train her further and build more 
muscle... She might undergo an incredible 
transformation!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah... That's 10 reps finished.
choice_data_list:
Think you can handle one more set after 
the break?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Hey, you. Chrono-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Gentil-san!? G-G-Good work 
today...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Gentildonna. A fierce 
noblewoman who proclaims that sheer 
strength is true power.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I saw your beach flags match earlier.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The kick-off right after getting up, a 
dash without the slightest sway to the 
left or right—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Magnificently done.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It's not strength, but pure resilience. If 
we hone it, wouldn't things get rather 
interesting?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That's all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ! Ah... Th-Th-Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
......T-To think Gentil-san would actually 
notice me...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I want to push myself and train to 
the limit too

Yeah, I'd like to train to the absolute 
limit, too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: W-Well then, really...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Please push my physical 
conditioning to the absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
For my stomach to growl at a time like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm eating three meals and 
snacking in between...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I'll whip up a light late-night 
snack.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono Genesis wanted to use the kitchen, 
so I went and got permission from the 
caretaker."
choice_data_list:
They said we can use the ingredients here. 
Is it enough?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's plenty. S-Sorry, and thank 
you, you really saved me...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um... if you'd like, would you care to 
have some too, Trainer...?
choice_data_list: Are you sure? I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: W-Well then, please wait a moment...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon the intrusion. Would I be able to 
borrow the kitchen as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ones who appeared were Duramente, the 
rising star of an athletic dynasty, and—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The delicious smell made my stomach growl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was Buena Vista, the pure, earnest, and 
devoted girl.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, go ahead... Um... i-if... uhm...
choice_data_list:
Actually, Chrono made too much. If you'd 
like...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Much obliged. Chrono, would you mind if I 
joined in?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes, of course! I-I hope it suits your 
taste...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, yay♪ Thank you, Chrono-chan.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal. The salmon 
chanchan-yaki was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It looks just like normal chanchan-yaki, 
but the flavor is so deep, I was totally 
surprised.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the nutritional balance is great 
too. It's ideal for getting plenty of 
protein.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I feel bad receiving such an exquisite 
late-night meal for free. I would like to 
repay you somehow—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Is there anything you wish for? If it is 
within my power, I shall do everything I 
can."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Same here as Duramente-san♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-A thank you is really unnecessary...! 
But... i-if possible, could we talk for a 
bit...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I don't mind. As long as it's before 
lights-out.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(This is... a chance to hear the true 
feelings behind the scenes of the 
race...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(I want to hear both of their stories! But 
time-wise, I can only listen to one of 
them...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "...T-Trainer-san. I-I can't choose..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Please choose, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The story Chrono Genesis wants to hear is 
likely about racing. If so—
choice_data_list: Maybe I should go talk to Duramente

I think Buena Vista's story will be a good 
reference.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! U-Um... If you find this impolite, 
please feel free to disregard it.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san carries enormous 
expectations from her entire family.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Did you perhaps not feel any pressure at 
all...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“—No. Expectations have been placed on me 
since the day I was born.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It is already a part of me. Therefore, I 
do not feel it as a burden.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"No... quite the opposite. The history of 
my clan has granted me strength."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I will carve open and carry on my 
family's history with these legs. I too 
wish to become a part of that history."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so you too recognize the sanctity of 
history. Then you should be able to turn 
that weight into strength.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: There is no need to fear.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! Not only such a valuable story, 
but advice as well...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for this... It's far too 
lavish a reward for just a late-night 
snack!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then... Um, Buena-san, you've 
competed against Triple Tiara Umamusume in 
GⅠ races, but—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara and... Ah, do you mean 
the Victoria Mile?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. I'd love to ask about your mindset 
when you competed against her...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Chrono-chan and the others have 
Ai-chan in the generation right above 
them, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I wasn't particularly fixated on 
the Triple Tiara, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Just when you think you're facing a 
Triple Tiara Umamusume—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because it feels like I'd just be using it 
as an excuse for losing.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If you forgive yourself like that, how are 
you going to connect it to the next step?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Well, I actually lost and had a huge 
self-reflection session, though.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Awawa, i-if I've offended you, I-I'm so 
sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, not at all. If anything, I'm glad 
I could help my junior.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I finally understand why Buena-san 
is so strong.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I will keep that in mind for the 
future...!
